headline: Vaxtex Cotfab reports AGM voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Vaxtex Cotfab Limited has submitted the voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. These standard corporate governance filings are submitted routinely following shareholder meetings. The disclosure informs shareholders of the resolutions passed during the AGM. Retail investors holding the stock can review the outcome for routine corporate updates.
why_it_matters: Routine AGM filing with no immediate financial impact on investors
